shared_elements: figures worked into a monumental stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry relief anthropomorphic figures with visible heads and arms, but that is essentially the only correspondence, and it is a generic one. A is a vertical, densely packed, symmetrical arrangement of frontal masks and ornamental scroll-and-glyph panels covering the whole shaft, while B is a sparse horizontal frieze of loose-limbed figures in active poses with raised arms, apparently interacting with one another against blank ground; the compositional logic, density and figural conventions are quite different.
